def: GitHub's family of AI coding tools, from the 2021 code-completion assistant to agent mode in editors, the Copilot CLI, a cloud agent that opens pull requests, and Copilot code review.
practice: It reads .github/copilot-instructions.md, path-specific .instructions.md files and AGENTS.md and supports Agent Skills (as of November 2026); not to be confused with Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Studio.
